name: MeepleAI English Seed Evaluation Dataset
description: English-language seed evaluation dataset for the RAG retrieval-evaluation harness. Covers the 5 golden games (Catan, Wingspan, Dominion, Ark Nova, 7 Wonders) with unlabeled samples intended to be labeled via the labeling-assist workflow.

samples.question: What are the five resource types in Catan?
samples.expected_answer: The five resource types are brick, lumber, wool, grain, and ore.

samples.question: How many victory points are needed to win a game of Catan?
samples.expected_answer: A player needs 10 victory points to win the game.

samples.question: How many bird cards does each player start with in Wingspan?
samples.expected_answer: Each player starts with a hand of 5 bird cards, of which they may keep any number by discarding food tokens to pay for them.

samples.question: What are the three habitat rows on the player mat in Wingspan?
samples.expected_answer: The three habitat rows are Forest, Grassland, and Wetland, each associated with a different action when a bird is played there.

samples.question: How many action phases occur during a round in Dominion?
samples.expected_answer: A player's turn has three phases: Action, Buy, and Cleanup. The Action phase allows playing one Action card unless additional actions are gained.

samples.question: How many Copper, Silver, and Gold cards are in the supply for a 2-player game of Dominion?
samples.expected_answer: In a 2-player game the supply contains 46 Copper, 40 Silver, and 30 Gold cards.

samples.question: How does a player end their turn in Dominion, and what happens to unused cards?
samples.expected_answer: At Cleanup, the player discards their hand and all cards played this turn, then draws a new hand of 5 cards from their deck, reshuffling their discard pile if needed.

samples.question: What are the four action types available on the player's turn wheel in Ark Nova?
samples.expected_answer: The four action types are Build, Animals, Cards, and Association (X-tokens), each represented by a card the player plays face-up onto their action wheel.

samples.question: How does a player increase their reputation in Ark Nova?
samples.expected_answer: Reputation increases primarily by playing animals that satisfy their placement requirements and by fulfilling conservation project requirements; each action also advances the appeal and conservation tracks separately.

samples.question: How many ages are played in a game of 7 Wonders, and how many cards does each player draft per age?
samples.expected_answer: A game of 7 Wonders is played over 3 ages. In each age, every player is dealt a hand of 7 cards and drafts one card at a time by passing the remaining hand to a neighbor.

samples.question: In which direction do players pass cards during Age II of 7 Wonders?
samples.expected_answer: During Age II, cards are passed counter-clockwise (to the right), reversing the clockwise direction used in Age I.

samples.question: How is military conflict resolved at the end of each age in 7 Wonders?
samples.expected_answer: At the end of each age, each player compares their military strength (shield symbols) to both neighbors; the player with more shields wins a conflict token worth increasing victory points per age (1, 3, or 5), while the loser gets a -1 point defeat token.
